nodes.text: Let $n\geq 2$. Is there a space $S$ of dimension $n$ such that $S^2$ also has dimension $n$?

#909 : [Er82e] analysis | topology The space of rational points in Hilbert space has this property for $n=1$. This was proved for general $n$ by Anderson and Keisler [AnKe67] .
